entities.name: Menon of Pharsalus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Menon was a citizen of Pharsalus in Thessaly, and a man of great influence and reputation. He took a prominent part in the Lamian war, and commanded the Thessalian cavalry in the Battle of Melitaea.
